surface: Native Electron, isolated fake-agent rig, trusted UI input
scenario: Add account creates a distinct registered native runtime with its own removable slot and home. A preseeded native extra shares an id with an ignored ACP account row at a different home. Removing only that extra deletes its native runtime, row and home, while the primary and new account remain. Ignored ACP configuration and marker remain byte-identical; the sentinel never executes.
limits: Creation and removal were verified in one running app session. The fake provider returns a canned identity; no real sign-in, credential completion or restart persistence was validated. Approval races and forced allocation/registration failures are Host tests, not these frames.
privacy: Nine recorded text/account audit checkpoints were empty, including before and after each capture. Worker and parent visually inspected both original PNGs.
